questionText: If a card says when I attack is that occurring before a showdown begins?
question: When does a 'When I attack' triggered ability fire relative to the showdown / combat?
assumptions: RiftJudge p0941 — abstract question about when 'When I attack' triggers occur. The bridge's rules-demo when-i-attack topic explains: the engine dispatches an `attack` event when units become attackers, BEFORE the Combat Damage Step (rule 459.2.b / 461.2.a). The triggered ability goes on the chain at this point, BEFORE damage is dealt. The Showdown 'begins' when the battlefield becomes Contested; the attack/defend designation triggers fire as part of the Combat that resolves at that showdown.
